failure_signature: TypeError: _fixture_search_pexels_candidates() got an unexpected keyword argument 'provider_state'
symptoms: hook-on-e2e job printed 'FIXTURE E2E COMPLETE | mode=on' and the render completed, but 'HOOK VISUAL AUDIT JSON' never appeared in the log
every grep-based assertion depending on the Hook-visual audit output failed even though the job's own script did not raise visibly

video/video_engine.py's broad 'except Exception as e:' around the fetch_hook_pexels_video() call site printed only a one-line warning and silently fell back to the general fetch_video(keyword) path, masking the real exception

root_cause.summary: ci_video_provider_hotfix.py's own patch to fetch_hook_pexels_video() (part of INC-2026-001's provider_state-threading design) calls search_video_candidates(query, per_page=..., provider_state=...), but quality/hook_e2e_fixture.py's monkeypatch stub _fixture_search_pexels_candidates(query, per_page) had no provider_state parameter. Every call raised TypeError, which is not ProviderRateLimitedError/ProviderTransientError, so it was not caught inside fetch_hook_pexels_video() -- it propagated up to video_engine.py's broad except Exception, which silently fell back to a non-hook-specific video and never reached print_hook_visual_audit().

evidence.note: hook-on-e2e failure on head a8d371d9bb43f1a3364fd97eb3a09b4f8c4955bf; log shows FIXTURE E2E COMPLETE printed with no HOOK VISUAL AUDIT JSON before it, and 'Process completed with exit code 1' immediately after, consistent with a later grep assertion failing on the missing audit output.
_fixture_search_pexels_candidates(query, per_page) -- stub signature missing provider_state before the fix.
patched fetch_hook_pexels_video() call site passing provider_state=provider_state, the source of the mismatch.

fix.summary: Added provider_state=None to _fixture_search_pexels_candidates()'s signature, matching the *args/**kwargs pattern already used correctly by the other hv.search_video_candidates stubs elsewhere in the test suite (quality/hook_production_parity_regression_test.py, quality/hook_fallback_quality_floor_regression_test.py).

relationships.note: Introduced while implementing INC-2026-001's provider_state-threading fix, within the same PR #436, and caught by that same PR's own CI before landing.
